fusions.name: Hoofbeat Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and strikes it for 12 damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Thistle Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks up thistles around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trail Oats
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds and 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Deep Clover
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
